Cancer nature

Cancer is ruled by the Moon and is traditionally the sign of home, family and feeling. It is associated with care, memory and a strong protective instinct towards the people it loves. Cancer is often described as intuitive and emotionally perceptive; like its symbol, the crab, it can retreat into its shell when hurt, and is said to take time to trust.

Cancer in love and work

In love Cancer is associated with loyalty and a deep need for emotional security. At work it is linked with caring professions, hospitality, food, property and teaching — roles that make people feel looked after.

Which sign is mine?

In India, "your rashi" usually means your Vedic Moon sign, which needs your birth time and is often different from the Western sun sign you get from your birthday alone. If you are not sure which you are, the free calculators will tell you both.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Is Cancer the same as Kark rashi?

Yes — Kark is the Hindi name for the same sign. What can differ is how you work out which sign is yours: by your Western sun sign (21 June – 22 July) or by your Vedic Moon sign, which needs your birth time.

Which planet rules Cancer?

Moon. That is why Monday, the day of Moon, is traditionally considered Cancer's day, and why remedies for the sign often involve Moon.

Which signs are traditionally compatible with Cancer?

Scorpio, Pisces, Capricorn are the traditional pairings: the other signs of its element, and the seventh sign, the house of partnership. Real compatibility is judged from two full birth charts through kundli matching, not from signs alone.
